methods.description: Progressive disclosure of the Sail authoring surface from compiler SSOT. Pass topic: core | layout | style | tokens | l1 | control-flow.

topic.description: core | layout | style | tokens | l1 | control-flow

methods.description: Run Sail lint/compile diagnostics for a file path or inline source. Returns structured JSON diagnostics (severity, rule, message, line/col, optional rewrite FixPlan). Optional `fix`: off|suggest|apply for confluent allow-listed rewrites (sail-compose-rhythm, sail-compose-contrast, sail-compose-spacing, sail-no-raw-container, sail-sx typo, participation-style, display-on-layout, prefer-primitive). Prefer `source` for snippets; `path` reads any readable filesystem path (local agent trust model).

fix.description: Auto-fix: `off` | `suggest` | `apply`. Default `off` (unattended). `suggest` attaches machine fix payloads without writing; `apply` rewrites the file when `path` is set (or returns fixed `source` when inline).

includeTs.description: When true (default), merge mapped tsgo TypeScript diagnostics into structure/check results (SPEC-LSP-1 studio gutters). Soft-noops when tsgo is absent. Set `false` for structure-only / faster agent polls.

methods.description: Typed hover at a 1-based .sail position. Uses sail-lsp virtual_ts + tsgo for controller/scope/template TS regions; structure symbols otherwise. Soft-degrades when tsgo is absent.

contents.description: Markdown hover contents. Empty/absent when nothing to show.

methods.description: Completions at a 1-based .sail position. Proxies tsgo inside TS regions; falls back to structure scope symbols. Soft-degrades when tsgo is absent.

Structured grammar-aware Sail edits (insert/replace/wrap/setAttr/removeAttr/setSx/move). Atomic batch; validates before write so the file never holds an uncompilable intermediate. Response: applied, modelRevision, diagnostics, autoFixed[].

dryRun.description: When true, validate and return result without writing disk.

path.description: Workspace-relative `.sail` path (required to write; used for node identity).

source.description: Optional inline source (else file is read). Dry-run without write when combined with dryRun.

methods.description: Taffy layout feedback for agents: multi-viewport diagnostics + computed box tree (x/y/w/h, collapsed flags). Run after layout edits. Prefer `source` for snippets.
List workspace-relative .sail paths under a project (routes/src/packs). Studio explorer seed.

project.description: Workspace-relative project root (`apps/sail-site`). Default: ops project.

methods.description: Compiler policy registry (SPEC-POLICY-1). mode=list returns types/defaults/descriptions; mode=get returns the same rows plus resolved values. Same payload as `sail-compiler policy --json` and GET /_deck/policy.

project.description: Optional project directory for `get` (workspace-relative or absolute).

methods.description: Canonical per-file Sail model (tree, layout, state, diagnostics, data, theme). Source-derived; modelVersion 1.

source.description: Author `.sail` source (same bytes Model inspected). Studio Source view.

methods.description: IR element tree with span-keyed node ids for a .sail file.
Scope bindings with template readers/writers and SSR tier badges (S/I/C).
Blast radius for a design token: component count + source sites (file + span).
DTCG theme graph: tiers, {alias} edges, values from theme JSON only (never CSS).
List theme JSON files under a directory. Path must be apps/*/tokens/themes or packages/sail/tokens/model/themes.
Read a project or catalog theme JSON file (workspace-relative path).
Write a project theme JSON. Allowlist: apps/*/tokens/themes/**/*.json only.
Delete a project theme JSON. Allowlist: apps/*/tokens/themes/**/*.json only (catalog refused).
Fork a catalog or project theme into apps/*/tokens/themes/. Optional new_id rewrites $extensions.ship.themeId.
Run DTCG model → tokens CSS/registry generate. mode=package (full catalog) or mode=app (T0 effective set → project/.deck/themes/themes.css only).
List effective theme ids for a project: project stems + catalog allowlist (T0 enabled ∩ catalog files).
Search Google Fonts catalog (cached) by family query. Offline fallback list when network unavailable.
Vendor a font family: download subsetted woff2 → project/fonts + @font-face + license manifest + typography tokens. Offline after selection; no runtime CDN.

project.description: App root (e.g. `apps/studio`). Defaults to ctx / first apps/* with routes.

methods.description: Start (or ensure) a local sail dev server for a project so HMR/studio HTTP exists. Theme ops do not require a server.
Status of the MCP-tracked dev server (running, url).
Stop the MCP-started dev server only (does not kill unrelated sail dev processes).
List ephemeral project tasks under <project>/.sail/tasks (gitignored). Filters: status/label/actor/drift/open. Includes anchor drift.
Get full task JSON (title, status, anchor, events, artifacts, drift).
Create a task (ULID id) under <project>/.sail/tasks. Optional anchor + body. Ephemeral — not team SSOT.

anchor.description: A-anchor `{ nodeId, elementPath?, contentHash?, file?, span? }`.

methods.description: Update task fields. Status changes append a status event (any→any in v1).
Append a comment to the task thread.
Attach an artifact (≤5MB). kind file|render; render carries region metadata. content_base64+filename or path.
Append an agent progress/summary note (actor kind=agent).
Create an A-anchored thread (required anchor { nodeId, elementPath?, contentHash? }). Same store as Create.

anchor.description: Required A-anchor `{ nodeId, elementPath?, contentHash?, file?, span? }`.

methods.description: Reply on a thread (comment with actor attribution).
List threads with anchor drift (ok|moved|lost). Filters: open/actor/drift/status.
Explicitly re-anchor a thread to a new node (lost never rebinds silently).
Export thread as a decision record under <project>/decisions/ (committable). .sail/tasks stays gitignored.
Static themed screenshot from a .sail file or inline source (no browser). Returns PNG base64 + regions (node ids) + dynamics list.

theme.description: Theme id (e.g. `ship`). Mode may be folded as `ship-dark`.
